    35	function deepFreeze(v) {
    36	  if (v === null || typeof v !== 'object') return v;
    37	  Object.freeze(v);
    38	  var names = Object.getOwnPropertyNames(v);
    39	  for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) deepFreeze(v[names[i]]);
    40	  return v;
    41	}

    22	 *     the outcome side — the classifier derives all of them. The input wrapper has a
    23	 *     CLOSED key set; any caller-supplied outcome / class / classification field is an
    24	 *     UNKNOWN_OWN_KEY → BLOCK before any further read.
    25	 *   • Confirmed requires ALL of:

   // ---------- Input descriptor snapshot --------------------------------------------------------
   // Mirrors D5 snapshotInputDescriptors: walks own descriptors (NOT [[Get]]) so a Proxy with

   function _snapshotPlainShape(o, allowedKeys, invalidCode, opts) {

   299	      var p = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_PROTO(v);
   300	      return p === Object.prototype || p === null;
   301	    } catch (e) { return false; }
   302	  }
   303	  function _isPlainArray(v) {
   304	    try {
   305	      if (!_CAPTURED_ARRAY_IS_ARRAY(v)) return false;
   306	      var p = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_PROTO(v);
   307	      return p === Array.prototype;
   308	    } catch (e) { return false; }
   309	  }
   310	  function _hasSymbolOwnKey(o) {
   311	    try {
   312	      var syms = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_SYMS(o);
   313	      return _CAPTURED_ARRAY_IS_ARRAY(syms) && syms.length > 0;
   314	    } catch (e) { return true; }
   315	  }
   316	  function _nonEmptyStr(v) { return typeof v === 'string' && v.length > 0; }
   317	  function _isFiniteNumber(v) {
   318	    return typeof v === 'number' && _CAPTURED_NUMBER_IS_FINITE(v) === true;
   319	  }
   320	  function _isBool(v) { return v === true || v === false; }
   321	  function _idGrammarOk(s) {
   322	    if (!_nonEmptyStr(s)) return false;
   323	    if (_reTestE3(ID_FORBIDDEN_RE, s)) return false;
   324	    if (!_reTestE3(ID_GRAMMAR_RE, s)) return false;
   325	    return true;
   326	  }
   327	  // Codex E3-R1-02 closure: strict i18n-key grammar enforcement. driverFeedback (and any
   328	  // future i18n-keyed surface in the outcome) MUST pass this gate before being copied to
   329	  // the outcome envelope.
   330	  function _i18nKeyOk(s) {
   331	    if (!_nonEmptyStr(s)) return false;
   332	    if (s.length > I18N_KEY_MAX_LEN) return false;
   333	    if (!_reTestE3(I18N_KEY_RE, s)) return false;
   334	    return true;
   335	  }
   336	  // Codex E3-R1-01 / E3-R5-02 closure: null-prototype membership set backed by a
   337	  // closure-local captured Array (not an object map). add() uses captured
   338	  // Array.prototype.push via captured Reflect.apply; has() uses captured indexOf.
   339	  // This eliminates the entire `defineProperty` attack surface from the set abstraction
   340	  // (a hostile pre-load defineProperty cannot inject phantom keys because we never
   341	  // call defineProperty for membership tracking). The set is shape-private: it is a
   342	  // plain array of string keys, never exposed beyond the classifier closure.
   343	  function _newCapturedNullSet() {
   344	    return [];
   345	  }
   346	  function _capturedSetHas(setObj, key) {
   347	    if (!_isPlainArray(setObj)) return false;
   348	    return _arrIndexOf(setObj, key) !== -1;
   349	  }
   350	  function _capturedSetAdd(setObj, key) {
   351	    if (!_isPlainArray(setObj)) return false;
   352	    if (_arrIndexOf(setObj, key) !== -1) return true;
   353	    return _arrPush(setObj, key);
   354	  }
   355	
   356	  // Deep freeze using captured Object.freeze + captured getOwnPropertyNames.
   357	  function _deepFreeze(v) {
   358	    if (v === null || typeof v !== 'object') return v;
   359	    try { _CAPTURED_OBJECT_FREEZE(v); } catch (e) { /* swallow */ }
   360	    var keys;
   361	    try { keys = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_NAMES(v); } catch (e) { return v; }
   362	    for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
   363	      var k = keys[i];
   364	      var child;
   365	      try { child = v[k]; } catch (eGet) { continue; }
   366	      _deepFreeze(child);
   367	    }
   368	    return v;
   369	  }
   370	
   371	  // ---------- Input descriptor snapshot --------------------------------------------------------
   372	  // Mirrors D5 snapshotInputDescriptors: walks own descriptors (NOT [[Get]]) so a Proxy with
   373	  // hostile getters does NOT fire on first read. Symbol / non-enumerable / accessor / unknown
   374	  // own key → reject before any further inspection.
   375	  function _snapshotPlainShape(o, allowedKeys, invalidCode, opts) {
   376	    opts = opts || {};
   377	    if (!_isOriginalPlainObject(o)) {
   378	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode, CODES.PROTOTYPE_POLLUTION_REJECTED], detail: 'not plain' };
   379	    }
   380	    if (opts.requireFrozen && _isFrozenSafe(o) !== true) {
   381	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'not frozen' };
   382	    }
   383	    if (_hasSymbolOwnKey(o)) {
   384	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode, CODES.UNKNOWN_OWN_KEY], detail: 'symbol own key' };
   385	    }
   386	    var names;
   387	    try { names = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_NAMES(o); } catch (e) {
   388	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'descriptor read failed' };
   389	    }
   390	    var snap = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_CREATE(null);
   391	    for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
   392	      var k = names[i];
   393	      // Reject unknown own key — caller cannot smuggle `class`, `outcomeId`, `confounders`,
   394	      // etc. into the input wrapper.
   395	      if (_arrIndexOf(allowedKeys, k) === -1) {
   396	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode, CODES.UNKNOWN_OWN_KEY], detail: 'unknown own key ' + k };
   397	      }
   398	      var d;
   399	      try { d = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_DESC(o, k); } catch (e) {
   400	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'descriptor inaccessible' };
   401	      }
   402	      if (!d || d.enumerable !== true) {
   403	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'non-enumerable key ' + k };
   404	      }
   405	      if (typeof d.get === 'function' || typeof d.set === 'function') {
   406	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'accessor key ' + k };
   407	      }
   408	      snap[k] = d.value;
   409	    }
   410	    return { valid: true, snapshot: snap };
   411	  }
   412	
   413	  // Codex E3-R1-03 closure: dense-array enforcement. Reject sparse arrays (any index in
   414	  // 0..length-1 missing an enumerable data descriptor → hole) AND reject any own key
   415	  // other than 'length' or a canonical numeric index (no Symbol keys, no string names,
   416	  // no negative / fractional / leading-zero indices). The walk indexes BY index, not by
   417	  // getOwnPropertyNames enumeration order, so a hostile array that puts named own keys
   418	  // first cannot smuggle a hole past the cap check.
   419	  function _snapshotArrayShape(a, invalidCode) {
   420	    if (!_isPlainArray(a)) {
   421	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'not array' };
   422	    }
   423	    if (_hasSymbolOwnKey(a)) {
   424	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode, CODES.UNKNOWN_OWN_KEY], detail: 'symbol own key on array' };
   425	    }
   426	    var aLen;
   427	    try { aLen = a.length; } catch (e) {
   428	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'array length inaccessible' };
   429	    }
   430	    if (typeof aLen !== 'number' || !_CAPTURED_NUMBER_IS_INTEGER(aLen) || aLen < 0 || aLen > ARRAY_CAP) {
   431	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode, CODES.ARRAY_CAP_EXCEEDED], detail: 'array len ' + aLen };
   432	    }
   433	    // First sweep: enumerate own keys and reject ANY name other than 'length' or a
   434	    // canonical numeric index in [0, aLen). Reject Symbol keys (already above), reject
   435	    // non-enumerable / accessor / non-data descriptors on indices.
   436	    var names;
   437	    try { names = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_NAMES(a); } catch (e) {
   438	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'array desc inaccessible' };
   439	    }
   440	    for (var ni = 0; ni < names.length; ni++) {
   441	      var nm = names[ni];
   442	      if (nm === 'length') continue;
   443	      if (!_reTestE3(ARRAY_INDEX_RE, nm)) {
   444	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode, CODES.UNKNOWN_OWN_KEY], detail: 'non-index own key on array: ' + nm };
   445	      }
   446	      var idxN = +nm;
   447	      if (idxN < 0 || idxN >= aLen) {
   448	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'array index out of [0,length): ' + nm };
   449	      }
   450	      var dn;
   451	      try { dn = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_DESC(a, nm); } catch (e) {
   452	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'array elt desc fail' };
   453	      }
   454	      if (!dn || dn.enumerable !== true) {
   455	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'non-enumerable array elt at ' + nm };
   456	      }
   457	      if (typeof dn.get === 'function' || typeof dn.set === 'function') {
   458	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'accessor array elt at ' + nm };
   459	      }
   460	    }
   461	    // Second sweep: walk by index 0..aLen-1. Every index MUST have an OWN enumerable
   462	    // data descriptor (no holes, no prototype-inherited values).
   463	    var snap = [];
   464	    for (var i = 0; i < aLen; i++) {
   465	      var key = '' + i;
   466	      var d;
   467	      try { d = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_DESC(a, key); } catch (e) {
   468	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'array elt desc fail at ' + i };
   469	      }
   470	      if (!d) {
   471	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'sparse array hole at index ' + i };
   472	      }
   473	      if (d.enumerable !== true) {
   474	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'non-enumerable array elt at ' + i };
   475	      }
   476	      if (typeof d.get === 'function' || typeof d.set === 'function') {
   477	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'accessor array elt at ' + i };
   478	      }
   479	      _arrPush(snap, d.value);
   480	    }
   481	    return { valid: true, snapshot: snap };
   482	  }
   483	
   484	  function _snapshotOpts(optsIn) {
   485	    var snap = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_CREATE(null);
   486	    if (optsIn === undefined || optsIn === null) return { valid: true, snapshot: snap };
   487	    var r = _snapshotPlainShape(optsIn, OPTS_KEYS_ALLOWED, CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
   488	    if (r.valid !== true) return r;
   489	    // Type-check each opt.
   490	    if (r.snapshot.clock !== undefined && r.snapshot.clock !== null && typeof r.snapshot.clock !== 'function') {
   491	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], detail: 'opts.clock not function' };
   492	    }
   493	    if (r.snapshot.referenceNowMs !== undefined && r.snapshot.referenceNowMs !== null
   494	        && typeof r.snapshot.referenceNowMs !== 'number') {
   495	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], detail: 'opts.referenceNowMs not number' };
   496	    }
   497	    if (r.snapshot.maxAgeMs !== undefined && r.snapshot.maxAgeMs !== null
   498	        && (typeof r.snapshot.maxAgeMs !== 'number' || !_CAPTURED_NUMBER_IS_INTEGER(r.snapshot.maxAgeMs) || r.snapshot.maxAgeMs < 0)) {
   499	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], detail: 'opts.maxAgeMs invalid' };
   500	    }
   501	    return { valid: true, snapshot: r.snapshot };
   502	  }
   503	
   504	  // ---------- Deterministic ID generator -------------------------------------------------------
   505	  // outcomeId is deterministic from (experimentId, changeId). No clock leak.
   506	  // Formal E Gate R1-01 / R2-02 closures (mirrors E4 R5/R6 + R3-02): capture-free
   507	  // hex padding via local hex lookup + bracket access; captured charCodeAt + RegExp.test
   508	  // already declared at top-of-module (see _RE_TEST_E3 / _STR_CHAR_CODE_AT_E3_EARLY).
   509	  function _charCodeAtE3(s, i) {
   510	    if (typeof s !== 'string') return 0;
   511	    try { return _CAPTURED_REFLECT_APPLY(_STR_CHAR_CODE_AT_E3_EARLY, s, [i]); } catch (e) { return 0; }
   512	  }
   513	  function _toHex8E3(h) {
   514	    var hexChars = '0123456789abcdef';
   515	    var out = '';
   516	    var x = h >>> 0;
   517	    for (var i = 7; i >= 0; i--) {
   518	      var nibble = (x >>> (i * 4)) & 0xF;
   519	      out += hexChars[nibble];
   520	    }
   521	    return out;
   522	  }
   523	  function _hash32(s) {
   524	    var h = 0x811c9dc5;
   525	    var len = typeof s === 'string' ? s.length : 0;
   526	    for (var i = 0; i < len; i++) {
   527	      h ^= _charCodeAtE3(s, i);
   528	      h = (h + ((h << 1) + (h << 4) + (h << 7) + (h << 8) + (h << 24))) >>> 0;
   529	    }
   530	    return _toHex8E3(h);
   531	  }
   532	  function _fnv2(s) {
   533	    var slen = typeof s === 'string' ? s.length : 0;
   534	    return _hash32(s) + _hash32(s + '|' + slen);
   535	  }
   536	  function _outcomeId(experimentId, changeId) {
   537	    return 'outcome_' + _fnv2('outcome|' + experimentId + '|' + changeId);
   538	  }
   539	
   540	  // ---------- Main entry: classifyOutcome -----------------------------------------------------
   541	  /**
   542	   * classifyOutcome(input, opts) — produces a deep-frozen Outcome envelope.
   543	   *
   544	   * Ordered steps (clock MUST NOT fire before Step 9):
   545	   *   0.  intrinsic integrity (captures + contract surfaces still frozen)
   546	   *   1.  input wrapper descriptor snapshot (closed keys; symbol/accessor/proxy rejected)
   547	   *   2.  experiment frozen + E1 shape validation
   548	   *   3.  appliedChange snapshot + shape
   549	   *   4.  followUp snapshot + shape
   550	   *   5.  observation snapshot + shape
   551	   *   6.  controlVariableObservations snapshot + per-element E1 shape
   552	   *   7.  opts snapshot
   553	   *   8.  identity binding (status=applied, sourceExperimentId match, parentCaseId match)
   554	   *   9.  resolve freshness reference time (clock at most once)
   555	   *   10. freshness check on experiment.createdAt + appliedChange.appliedAt
   556	   *   11. comparison-validity computation (invalid_comparison precedence)
   557	   *   12. control-variable integrity (inconclusive_due_to_confounders precedence)
   558	   *   13. data-quality + direction/magnitude classification cascade
   559	   *   14. compose outcome
   560	   *   15. validate via E1 OUT.validateOutcomeShape
   561	   *   16. envelope byte cap
   562	   *   17. deep-freeze + register
   563	   */
   564	  function classifyOutcome(inputIn, optsIn) {
   565	    try {
   566	      // ---- Step 0: intrinsic integrity ----------------------------------------------------
   567	      if (!_intrinsicsIntact()) {
   568	        return _buildTamperBlock('intrinsic tampering detected at entry');
   569	      }
   570	
   571	      // ---- Step 1: input wrapper descriptor snapshot -------------------------------------
   572	      var inSnapR = _snapshotPlainShape(inputIn, INPUT_KEYS_ALLOWED, CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID, { requireFrozen: false });
   573	      if (inSnapR.valid !== true) {
   574	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(inSnapR.reasonCodes, { detail: inSnapR.detail });
   575	      }
   576	      var inputSnap = inSnapR.snapshot;
   577	
   578	      // ---- Step 2: experiment shape validation -------------------------------------------
   579	      // The Experiment must be deep-frozen (immutability) AND pass the E1 contract.
   580	      if (!_isFrozenSafe(inputSnap.experiment)) {
   581	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.EXPERIMENT_INVALID], { detail: 'experiment not deep-frozen' });
   582	      }
   583	      var expCheck = EXP.validateExperimentShape(inputSnap.experiment);
   584	      if (expCheck.valid !== true) {
   585	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(
   586	          expCheck.reasonCodes ? _arrSlice(expCheck.reasonCodes) : [CODES.EXPERIMENT_INVALID],
   587	          { detail: 'experiment shape invalid' }
   588	        );
   589	      }
   590	      var experiment = inputSnap.experiment;
   591	
   592	      // ---- Step 3: appliedChange snapshot + shape ----------------------------------------
   593	      var acSnapR = _snapshotPlainShape(inputSnap.appliedChange, APPLIED_CHANGE_KEYS_ALLOWED, CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
   594	      if (acSnapR.valid !== true) {
   595	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(acSnapR.reasonCodes, { detail: 'appliedChange: ' + acSnapR.detail });
   596	      }
   597	      var appliedChange = acSnapR.snapshot;
   598	      if (!_idGrammarOk(appliedChange.changeId)) {
   599	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'appliedChange.changeId invalid' });
   600	      }
   601	      if (!_idGrammarOk(appliedChange.sourceExperimentId)) {
   602	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'appliedChange.sourceExperimentId invalid' });
   603	      }
   604	      if (!_nonEmptyStr(appliedChange.appliedAt) || _isoToMs(appliedChange.appliedAt) === null) {
   605	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'appliedChange.appliedAt invalid' });
   606	      }
   607	
   608	      // ---- Step 4: followUp snapshot + shape ---------------------------------------------
   609	      var fuSnapR = _snapshotPlainShape(inputSnap.followUp, FOLLOWUP_KEYS_ALLOWED, CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
   610	      if (fuSnapR.valid !== true) {
   611	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(fuSnapR.reasonCodes, { detail: 'followUp: ' + fuSnapR.detail });
   612	      }
   613	      var followUp = fuSnapR.snapshot;
   614	      if (!_idGrammarOk(followUp.followUpCaseId)) {
   615	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.LINKAGE_INVALID], { detail: 'followUp.followUpCaseId invalid' });
   616	      }
   617	      if (!_idGrammarOk(followUp.parentCaseId)) {
   618	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.LINKAGE_PARENT_MISSING], { detail: 'followUp.parentCaseId invalid' });
   619	      }
   620	      if (followUp.parentCaseId === followUp.followUpCaseId) {
   621	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.LINKAGE_INVALID], { detail: 'follow-up case is self-link' });
   622	      }
   623	      if (!_idGrammarOk(followUp.sessionId)) {
   624	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.LINKAGE_INVALID], { detail: 'followUp.sessionId invalid' });
   625	      }
   626	      if (!_idGrammarOk(followUp.parentSessionId)) {
   627	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.LINKAGE_INVALID], { detail: 'followUp.parentSessionId invalid' });
   628	      }
   629	      if (!_isBool(followUp.hasExplicitReference)) {
   630	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'followUp.hasExplicitReference not bool' });
   631	      }
   632	      if (!_isFiniteNumber(followUp.comparabilityScore) || followUp.comparabilityScore < 0 || followUp.comparabilityScore > 1) {
   633	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_COMPARABILITY_INSUFFICIENT], { detail: 'followUp.comparabilityScore out of [0,1]' });
   634	      }
   635	
   636	      // ---- Step 5: observation snapshot + shape ------------------------------------------
   637	      var obsSnapR = _snapshotPlainShape(inputSnap.observation, OBSERVATION_KEYS_ALLOWED, CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
   638	      if (obsSnapR.valid !== true) {
   639	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(obsSnapR.reasonCodes, { detail: 'observation: ' + obsSnapR.detail });
   640	      }
   641	      var observation = obsSnapR.snapshot;
   642	      // observedDirection: enum OR null
   643	      if (observation.observedDirection !== null && _arrIndexOf(DIRECTION_ALLOWED, observation.observedDirection) === -1) {
   644	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'observation.observedDirection invalid' });
   645	      }
   646	      // observedMagnitude: finite OR null
   647	      if (observation.observedMagnitude !== null && !_isFiniteNumber(observation.observedMagnitude)) {
   648	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'observation.observedMagnitude invalid' });
   649	      }
   650	      // driverFeedback: STRICT i18n key (dotted lower_snake_case, 2..6 segments, ≤128 chars)
   651	      // OR null. Codex E3-R1-02 closure: a non-empty-string check alone permits free-text
   652	      // blame / causation / paths to be laundered into the outcome envelope. The strict
   653	      // grammar rejects spaces, slashes, capital letters, and any character outside
   654	      // [a-z0-9._], blocking blame phrasing ("driver error because…") and path leakage
   655	      // ("/Users/…", "..\\etc\\…") at the contract boundary.
   656	      if (observation.driverFeedback !== null && !_i18nKeyOk(observation.driverFeedback)) {
   657	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_DRIVER_FEEDBACK_INVALID], { detail: 'driverFeedback not a strict i18n key' });
   658	      }
   659	      // dataQualityIssues / sideEffects / contradictingEvidenceIds / supportingEvidenceIds — bounded plain arrays.
   660	      var dqiR = _snapshotArrayShape(observation.dataQualityIssues, CODES.OUTCOME_DATA_QUALITY_INVALID);
   661	      if (dqiR.valid !== true) {
   662	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(dqiR.reasonCodes, { detail: 'dataQualityIssues: ' + dqiR.detail });
   663	      }
   664	      var dataQualityIssues = dqiR.snapshot;
   665	      // Codex E3-R7-01 closure (defence-in-depth): each data-quality issue MUST pass the
   666	      // strict i18n-key grammar. This bounds size (≤128 chars), eliminates the
   667	      // free-text / blame / path laundering vector, AND ensures byte-count overflow
   668	      // attacks via huge strings cannot inflate the envelope before the byte-cap walker
   669	      // sees it.
   670	      for (var qi = 0; qi < dataQualityIssues.length; qi++) {
   671	        if (!_i18nKeyOk(dataQualityIssues[qi])) {
   672	          return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_DATA_QUALITY_INVALID], { detail: 'dataQualityIssues[' + qi + '] not strict i18n key' });
   673	        }
   674	      }
   675	      var seR = _snapshotArrayShape(observation.sideEffects, CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
   676	      if (seR.valid !== true) {
   677	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(seR.reasonCodes, { detail: 'sideEffects: ' + seR.detail });
   678	      }
   679	      var sideEffects = seR.snapshot;
   680	      // Each side-effect must be a plain { i18nKey, params } object.
   681	      // Codex E3-R2-01 closure: i18nKey MUST pass the strict i18n grammar — same gate as
   682	      // driverFeedback — so free-text / blame / causation / path laundering through the
   683	      // side-effect surface is impossible.
   684	      // Codex E3-R2-02 closure: params is restricted to a CLOSED primitive allowlist
   685	      // (null OR plain object whose every value is a finite number / boolean / null).
   686	      // String values are FORBIDDEN to eliminate any free-text laundering vector. i18n
   687	      // substitution numerics (thresholds, magnitudes) remain expressible.
   688	      var SE_KEYS_FROZEN = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_FREEZE(['i18nKey', 'params']);
   689	      var rebuiltSideEffects = [];
   690	      for (var si = 0; si < sideEffects.length; si++) {
   691	        var se = sideEffects[si];
   692	        if (!_isOriginalPlainObject(se)) {
   693	          return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'sideEffects[' + si + '] not plain' });
   694	        }
   695	        var seKeysR = _snapshotPlainShape(se, SE_KEYS_FROZEN, CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
